test_title: PYST 57: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held on 05 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM for the highlighted word.**

She has a **penchant** for art and craft.
solution:
The correct answer is '**hatred**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Here are the meanings of the words and a sentence using the correct option:
 
 
• **Anxiety** (चिंता) - a feeling of worry, nervousness, or unease about something with an uncertain outcome.
 
• **Hatred** (नफ़रत) - intense dislike or ill will tow
